item.description:
DeskNames now checks for enabled macOS shortcut conflicts and occupied global shortcuts during setup. Keyboard settings provides the same check and a Recheck button. Some shortcuts local to other apps cannot be detected.

Quick controls and settings share one window with Back navigation. General groups startup, updates, menu-bar icon and desktop-name visibility, and hiding the window when switching apps. Reopening DeskNames restores access when the icon is hidden. Saved-window controls are simpler and available directly from the panel.

New installations use the updated default shortcuts. Existing custom bindings are preserved; choose Keyboard shortcuts > Shortcut options > Restore default shortcuts to adopt the defaults. Number-row and numpad digits now work alike. Fixed pane-layout selection on the original desktop when macOS supplies an empty desktop identifier, so creating a second desktop is no longer required.

This app is not notarized by Apple.
